```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)

# ── Load data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nathanielcross04/MPP-Capstone/refs/heads/main/Data/Final%20data/state_distances%20(raw%20and%20deltas).csv", check.names = FALSE)

YEARS       <- 2000:2019
DELTA_YEARS <- 2001:2019

# ── Extract a named list: state → vector of values across years ───────────────
extract_series <- function(prefix, years) {
  cols    <- paste0(prefix, "_", years)
  present <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
  yrs_out <- years[paste0(prefix, "_", years) %in% names(df)]
  mat     <- df[, present, drop = FALSE]
  list(
    years  = as.integer(yrs_out),
    states = df$state,
    values = lapply(seq_len(nrow(mat)), function(i) as.numeric(mat[i, ]))
  )
}

# ── Extract cluster assignments: state → vector of clusters across years ──────
extract_clusters <- function(years) {
  cols    <- paste0("cluster_", years)
  present <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
  yrs_out <- years[paste0("cluster_", years) %in% names(df)]
  mat     <- df[, present, drop = FALSE]
  list(
    years  = as.integer(yrs_out),
    states = df$state,
    values = lapply(seq_len(nrow(mat)), function(i) as.integer(mat[i, ]))
  )
}

# ── Build the full data payload ───────────────────────────────────────────────
payload <- list(
  global_raw          = extract_series("dist_1cs",            YEARS),
  global_raw_delta    = extract_series("dist_1cs_delta",      DELTA_YEARS),
  global_ranked       = extract_series("rank_1cs",            YEARS),
  global_ranked_delta = extract_series("rank_1cs_delta",      DELTA_YEARS),
  own_raw             = extract_series("dist_own",            YEARS),
  own_raw_delta       = extract_series("dist_own_delta",      DELTA_YEARS),
  own_ranked          = extract_series("rank_own",            YEARS),
  # own_ranked_delta  intentionally omitted — columns don't exist
  ext_raw             = extract_series("extremity",           YEARS),
  ext_raw_delta       = extract_series("extremity_delta",     DELTA_YEARS),
  ext_ranked          = extract_series("rank_extremity",      YEARS),
  ext_ranked_delta    = extract_series("rank_extremity_delta", DELTA_YEARS),
  clusters            = extract_clusters(YEARS)
)

json_payload <- toJSON(payload, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 6, na = "null")
```

```{=html}
  <div class="ctrl-section">
    <div class="ctrl-label">Variable Transformation</div>
    <div class="ctrl-row" id="row-transform">
      <button class="ctrl-btn active" data-val="raw"          onclick="setTransform(this)">Raw</button>
      <button class="ctrl-btn"        data-val="raw_delta"    onclick="setTransform(this)">Raw Deltas</button>
      <button class="ctrl-btn"        data-val="ranked"       onclick="setTransform(this)">Ranked</button>
      <button class="ctrl-btn"        data-val="ranked_delta" onclick="setTransform(this)">Ranked Deltas</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ctrl-section">
    <div class="ctrl-label">Color Scheme</div>
    <div class="ctrl-row" id="row-color">
      <button class="ctrl-btn active" data-val="none"          onclick="setColor(this)">No Color</button>
      <button class="ctrl-btn"        data-val="clusters"      onclick="setColor(this)">Colored Clusters</button>
      <button class="ctrl-btn"        data-val="extremes"      onclick="setColor(this)">Extremes</button>
      <button class="ctrl-btn"        data-val="top1"          onclick="setColor(this)">Top 1</button>
      <button class="ctrl-btn"        data-val="clusters_top1" onclick="setColor(this)">Colored Clusters + Top 1</button>
      <button class="ctrl-btn"        data-val="extremes_top1" onclick="setColor(this)">Extremes + Top 1</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="sub1" id="sub1"></div>
<div class="sub2" id="sub2"></div>
<div id="tbl-wrapper"><table id="main-dt" class="display"></table></div>

<!-- jQuery + DataTables JS -->
<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.0.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.6/js/jquery.dataTables.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/fixedcolumns/4.3.0/js/dataTables.fixedColumns.min.js"></script>

<script>
// ── Colour constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const CLUSTER_COLORS  = { "1": "#B5463A", "2": "#2E86B5" };
const CLUSTER_DESAT   = { "1": desat("#B5463A", 0.25), "2": desat("#2E86B5", 0.25) };
const EXTREMES_CLOSE  = "#009E73";
const EXTREMES_FAR    = "#D55E00";
const N_TOP           = 3;

// ── Subtitle text ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const SUB1 = {
  global:    "Proximity to the global centroid: Euclidean distance of each state from the overall centroid across all states and years.",
  own:       "Proximity to cluster centroid: Euclidean distance of each state from the centroid of its assigned cluster.",
  extremity: "Extremity: How far each state sits from the centre of the full distribution — a measure of uniqueness."
};

const SUB2 = {
  global: {
    none:          "",
    clusters:      "Cell fill shows each state's cluster membership (desaturated cluster colour).",
    extremes:      "Extremes: the 3 closest (#009E73) and 3 furthest (#D55E00) states each year are filled.",
    top1:          "Top 1: the single closest state each year is highlighted with a text bubble.",
    clusters_top1: "Cluster fills applied; the closest state each year carries a text bubble.",
    extremes_top1: "Extremes filled; the single closest state each year carries a text bubble."
  },
  own: {
    none:          "",
    clusters:      "Cell fill shows each state's cluster membership (desaturated cluster colour).",
    extremes:      "Extremes: the 3 closest states per cluster each year are filled using that cluster's colour.",
    top1:          "Top 1: the single closest state per cluster per year carries a text bubble.",
    clusters_top1: "Cluster fills applied; the closest state per cluster per year carries a text bubble.",
    extremes_top1: "Closest 3 per cluster filled; the single closest per cluster carries a text bubble."
  },
  extremity: {
    none:          "",
    clusters:      "Cell fill shows each state's cluster membership (desaturated cluster colour).",
    extremes:      "Extremes: the 3 most extreme (furthest) states each year are filled in #D55E00.",
    top1:          "Top 1: the single most extreme state each year carries a text bubble.",
    clusters_top1: "Cluster fills applied; the single most extreme state each year carries a text bubble.",
    extremes_top1: "Top 3 most extreme filled; the single most extreme state carries a text bubble."
  }
};

// ── State ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let curMeasure   = "global";
let curTransform = "raw";
let curColor     = "none";
let dtInstance   = null;

// ── Colour helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function hexToRgb(hex) {
  const r = parseInt(hex.slice(1,3),16)/255;
  const g = parseInt(hex.slice(3,5),16)/255;
  const b = parseInt(hex.slice(5,7),16)/255;
  return [r, g, b];
}
function rgbToHex(r, g, b) {
  return '#' + [r,g,b].map(v => Math.round(Math.min(1,Math.max(0,v))*255)
    .toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
}
function desat(hex, scale) {
  const [r,g,b] = hexToRgb(hex);
  const lum = 0.2126*r + 0.7152*g + 0.0722*b;
  return rgbToHex(lum + scale*(r-lum), lum + scale*(g-lum), lum + scale*(b-lum));
}
function lighten(hex, amount) {
  const [r,g,b] = hexToRgb(hex);
  return rgbToHex(r + amount*(1-r), g + amount*(1-g), b + amount*(1-b));
}

// ── Index helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Returns indices (0-based) of the N smallest values in an array
function nSmallest(arr, n) {
  return arr
    .map((v,i) => ({v, i}))
    .filter(x => x.v !== null && !isNaN(x.v))
    .sort((a,b) => a.v - b.v)
    .slice(0, n)
    .map(x => x.i);
}
function nLargest(arr, n) {
  return arr
    .map((v,i) => ({v, i}))
    .filter(x => x.v !== null && !isNaN(x.v))
    .sort((a,b) => b.v - a.v)
    .slice(0, n)
    .map(x => x.i);
}
function nSmallestAbs(arr, n) {
  return arr
    .map((v,i) => ({v: Math.abs(v), i}))
    .filter(x => x.v !== null && !isNaN(x.v))
    .sort((a,b) => a.v - b.v)
    .slice(0, n)
    .map(x => x.i);
}
function nLargestAbs(arr, n) {
  return arr
    .map((v,i) => ({v: Math.abs(v), i}))
    .filter(x => x.v !== null && !isNaN(x.v))
    .sort((a,b) => b.v - a.v)
    .slice(0, n)
    .map(x => x.i);
}

// ── Compute per-column highlight sets ─────────────────────────────────────────
// Returns, for each column index, a Map of rowIndex → {cellBg, bubbleBg|null}
function computeHighlights(colVals, clusterColVals, measure, isDelta, colorMode) {
  // colVals: array of values for one year-column (length = nStates)
  // clusterColVals: array of cluster ids for the same year

  const highlights = new Map(); // rowIdx → {cellBg, bubbleBg}

  let closeIdx = new Set();
  let farIdx   = new Set();
  let top1Idx  = new Set();

  if (measure === "own") {
    // Closest N per cluster (no far side for extremes)
    const clusters = [...new Set(clusterColVals.filter(c => c !== null))];
    clusters.forEach(cl => {
      const inCl = colVals
        .map((v,i) => ({v, i}))
        .filter(x => clusterColVals[x.i] == cl && x.v !== null && !isNaN(x.v));
      const sorted = inCl.sort((a,b) => a.v - b.v);
      sorted.slice(0, N_TOP).forEach(x => closeIdx.add(x.i));
      if (sorted.length > 0) top1Idx.add(sorted[0].i);
    });

  } else if (measure === "extremity") {
    if (!isDelta) {
      nLargest(colVals, N_TOP).forEach(i => farIdx.add(i));
      const t = nLargest(colVals, 1); if (t.length) top1Idx.add(t[0]);
    } else {
      // most stable = smallest absolute delta
      nSmallestAbs(colVals, N_TOP).forEach(i => closeIdx.add(i));
      const t = nSmallestAbs(colVals, 1); if (t.length) top1Idx.add(t[0]);
    }

  } else {
    // global
    if (!isDelta) {
      nSmallest(colVals, N_TOP).forEach(i => closeIdx.add(i));
      nLargest(colVals,  N_TOP).forEach(i => farIdx.add(i));
      const t = nSmallest(colVals, 1); if (t.length) top1Idx.add(t[0]);
    } else {
      nSmallestAbs(colVals, N_TOP).forEach(i => closeIdx.add(i));
      nLargestAbs(colVals,  N_TOP).forEach(i => farIdx.add(i));
      const t = nSmallestAbs(colVals, 1); if (t.length) top1Idx.add(t[0]);
    }
  }

  // Now assign colors per row
  colVals.forEach((_, rowIdx) => {
    const cl      = clusterColVals ? String(clusterColVals[rowIdx]) : null;
    let cellBg    = null;
    let bubbleBg  = null;

    // --- cell background ---
    if (colorMode === "clusters" || colorMode === "clusters_top1") {
      if (cl && CLUSTER_DESAT[cl]) cellBg = CLUSTER_DESAT[cl];
    }

    if (colorMode === "extremes" || colorMode === "extremes_top1") {
      if (measure === "own") {
        if (closeIdx.has(rowIdx) && cl && CLUSTER_COLORS[cl])
          cellBg = CLUSTER_COLORS[cl];
      } else if (measure === "extremity") {
        if (farIdx.has(rowIdx))   cellBg = EXTREMES_FAR;
        if (closeIdx.has(rowIdx)) cellBg = EXTREMES_CLOSE; // only for delta
      } else {
        if (closeIdx.has(rowIdx)) cellBg = EXTREMES_CLOSE;
        if (farIdx.has(rowIdx))   cellBg = EXTREMES_FAR;
      }
    }

    // --- bubble ---
    const isTop1 = (colorMode === "top1" || colorMode === "clusters_top1" ||
                    colorMode === "extremes_top1") && top1Idx.has(rowIdx);
    if (isTop1) {
      const base = cellBg || (cl && CLUSTER_DESAT[cl]) || "#888888";
      bubbleBg   = lighten(base, 0.55);
    }

    if (cellBg || bubbleBg) {
      highlights.set(rowIdx, { cellBg, bubbleBg });
    }
  });

  return highlights;
}

// ── Build DataTable data array ────────────────────────────────────────────────
function buildTableData() {
  const key = curMeasure === "extremity"
    ? "ext_" + curTransform
    : curMeasure + "_" + curTransform;

  const slice    = RAW_DATA[key];
  const clustDat = RAW_DATA.clusters;
  if (!slice) return null;

  const states = slice.states;
  const years  = slice.years;
  const isDelta = curTransform.includes("delta");
  const isRanked = curTransform.includes("ranked");

  // Build column → array of values
  const nStates = states.length;
  const nYears  = years.length;

  // values[stateIdx][yearIdx]
  const vals = slice.values;

  // Cluster values per year: clust[stateIdx] = array over clustDat.years
  // We need cluster for the matching year
  const clustYearMap = {};
  clustDat.years.forEach((yr, ci) => { clustYearMap[yr] = ci; });

  // For each year-column, compute highlights
  const colHighlights = years.map((yr, yi) => {
    const colVals   = vals.map(row => row[yi]);
    const clustColI = clustYearMap[yr];
    const clustVals = (clustColI !== undefined)
      ? clustDat.values.map(row => row[clustColI])
      : new Array(nStates).fill(null);
    return computeHighlights(colVals, clustVals, curMeasure, isDelta, curColor);
  });

  // Build rows: each row = [stateName, val_yr0, val_yr1, ...]
  const rows = states.map((state, si) => {
    const row = [state];
    years.forEach((yr, yi) => {
      const raw = vals[si][yi];
      const hl  = colHighlights[yi].get(si);

      // Format number
      const disp = (raw === null || raw === undefined || isNaN(raw))
        ? ""
        : isRanked
          ? (Number.isInteger(raw) ? raw : raw.toFixed(1))
          : raw.toFixed(4);

      if (!hl) {
        row.push(`<div class="cv">${disp}</div>`);
      } else {
        const bgStyle = hl.cellBg
          ? `background:${hl.cellBg};`
          : "";
        const textColor = hl.cellBg ? "color:#111;" : "";
        if (hl.bubbleBg) {
          row.push(
            `<div class="cv" style="${bgStyle}${textColor}">` +
            `<span class="bubble" style="background:${hl.bubbleBg};">${disp}</span>` +
            `</div>`
          );
        } else {
          row.push(`<div class="cv" style="${bgStyle}${textColor}">${disp}</div>`);
        }
      }
    });
    return row;
  });

  return { years, rows };
}

// ── Render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function render() {
  // Update subtitles
  document.getElementById("sub1").textContent = SUB1[curMeasure] || "";
  const s2 = (SUB2[curMeasure] || {})[curColor] || "";
  document.getElementById("sub2").textContent = s2;

  const result = buildTableData();
  if (!result) {
    document.getElementById("tbl-wrapper").innerHTML =
      '<p style="color:#c00;padding:1rem;">Not available for this combination.</p>';
    return;
  }

  const { years, rows } = result;
  const columns = [{ title: "State" }].concat(years.map(y => ({ title: String(y) })));

  // Destroy old instance
  if (dtInstance) {
    dtInstance.destroy();
    document.getElementById("tbl-wrapper").innerHTML =
      '<table id="main-dt" class="display"></table>';
  }

  dtInstance = $('#main-dt').DataTable({
    data:       rows,
    columns:    columns,
    paging:     false,
    searching:  false,
    info:       false,
    ordering:   true,
    scrollX:    true,
    fixedColumns: { leftColumns: 1 },
    createdRow: function(row) {
      // Remove default DT padding from td so our .cv div fills completely
      $(row).find('td').css('padding', '0');
    },
    columnDefs: [
      { targets: 0, width: "120px", className: "dt-left" },
      { targets: "_all", className: "dt-center", width: "62px" }
    ],
    dom: 't'
  });
}

// ── Button handlers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function setMeasure(btn) {
  curMeasure = btn.dataset.val;
  document.querySelectorAll("#row-measure .ctrl-btn")
    .forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn));
  enforceConstraints();
  render();
}

function setTransform(btn) {
  if (btn.classList.contains("disabled")) return;
  curTransform = btn.dataset.val;
  document.querySelectorAll("#row-transform .ctrl-btn")
    .forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn));
  render();
}

function setColor(btn) {
  curColor = btn.dataset.val;
  document.querySelectorAll("#row-color .ctrl-btn")
    .forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn));
  render();
}

// ── Constraints ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function enforceConstraints() {
  const rdBtn = document.querySelector('[data-val="ranked_delta"]');
  if (curMeasure === "own") {
    rdBtn.classList.add("disabled");
    if (curTransform === "ranked_delta") {
      curTransform = "raw_delta";
      document.querySelectorAll("#row-transform .ctrl-btn")
        .forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.val === curTransform));
    }
  } else {
    rdBtn.classList.remove("disabled");
  }
}

// ── Init ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$(document).ready(function () {
  enforceConstraints();
  render();
});
</script>
```
